summary: PR 7403 backfilled unique Bicep module telemetry prefixes by rotating all 608 existing current IDs with the merged authoring generator. It merged after approval from jtracey93.
proposed: Telemetry prefixes needed to be unique per module and generated in the form 46d3xbcp.<res|ptn|utl>.<seven lowercase hex>.
changed: The scaffolding requests prefixes from Avm.Authoring New-AvmTelemetryIdPrefix and fails with install guidance when it is unavailable, and each previous ID is preserved under alternativeTelemetryIdPrefixes. 543 telemetry-bearing main.json templates were regenerated, and take(..., 64) wrappers were removed from 32 telemetry deployment names because their maximum length is now 34 characters.
shipped: The new prefixes, regenerated templates and the 32 deployment-name simplifications merged in one commit across 269 code areas.
